facts.fact: Daily News reported that Tanzania and the DRC agreed to accelerate a fibre-optic cable from Kigoma in Tanzania to Kalemie in DRC across Lake Tanganyika, a commitment their foreign minister reaffirmed at a meeting in Dar es Salaam; the two are described as pursuing its construction, with no cost, contract, start of works or timetable stated and no date given for the original agreement.
